# Assignment: data analysis of simulated data

## 0. Library

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(edgeR)
library(ggrepel) 
library(pheatmap)
library(umap)
```

## 1. Data import & smaller fixes

```{r}

data_org <- read.csv2("analysis_of_other_data/scRNAseq_data_updated.csv", sep = ",")

data <- data_org
rownames(data) = data_org[,1]

data <- data[,2:ncol(data)]

## Transpose and add columns(patient, group, cell_id)
t_data <- t(data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    patient = sub("_.*", "", rownames(.)),
    group   = ifelse(grepl("_control_", rownames(.)), "Control", "Disease"),
    cell_id = sub(".*_(cell\\d+)$", "\\1", rownames(.))
  ) %>%
  relocate(cell_id, patient, group)

head(rownames(t_data)) 

```

## 2. QC

```{r}

# QC preparation

# Keep only gene expression columns
expression_data <- t_data %>%
  select(-cell_id, -patient, -group)

# Convert expression values to a numeric matrix
expression_matrix <- as.matrix(expression_data)

# Check dimensions
dim(expression_matrix)

# Check that expression values are numeric and non-negative
summary(as.vector(expression_matrix))
any(is.na(expression_matrix))
any(expression_matrix < 0)

# Calculate QC metrics for each cell
qc_data <- data.frame(
  cell_id        = t_data$cell_id,
  patient        = t_data$patient,
  group          = t_data$group,
  total_counts   = rowSums(expression_matrix),
  detected_genes = rowSums(expression_matrix > 0)
)

head(qc_data)
summary(qc_data)
table(qc_data$group)


# Identify potential outliers (1.5 x IQR rule, per group) – flag only, no filtering
qc_data <- qc_data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(
    potential_outlier =
      detected_genes < quantile(detected_genes, 0.25) - 1.5 * IQR(detected_genes) |
      detected_genes > quantile(detected_genes, 0.75) + 1.5 * IQR(detected_genes)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Number and percentage of potential outliers per group
qc_data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells     = n(),
    n_outliers  = sum(potential_outlier),
    pct_outliers = round(mean(potential_outlier) * 100, 2)
  )

# QC metrics by group
qc_data %>%
  select(group, total_counts, detected_genes) %>%
  pivot_longer(-group, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = recode(metric,
                         total_counts   = "Total counts per cell",
                         detected_genes = "Detected genes per cell")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = value, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Quality control metrics by group", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# total counts vs detected genes
ggplot(qc_data, aes(x = total_counts, y = detected_genes, color = group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Total counts vs detected genes",
    x = "Total counts per cell",
    y = "Number of detected genes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


patient_qc <- qc_data %>%
  group_by(patient, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells             = n(),
    mean_detected_genes = mean(detected_genes),
    mean_total_counts   = mean(total_counts),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(group, patient)

patient_qc
table(patient_qc$group)   # number of subjects per group


```


## 3. Normalisation

```{r}

# Patient and group from the cell names, e.g. "P01_control_cell001"
parts = do.call(rbind, strsplit(colnames(data), "_"))
meta  = data.frame(cell = colnames(data), patient = parts[,1], group = parts[,2])

sum(rowSums(data) == 0) ## no rows/genes that are 0 everywhere (across all groups/subjects/cells)

## Cell level: counts per 10,000, then log (used for the cell-level analyses in section 5)
counts_per_cell = colSums(data)                           # Total counts per cell
lognorm = log1p(t(t(data) / counts_per_cell) * 10000)     # Counts per 10,000, then log

gene_mean = rowMeans(lognorm)
gene_var  = apply(lognorm, 1, var)
trend     = loess(gene_var ~ gene_mean)        # How variance normally follows the mean
excess    = gene_var - predict(trend)          # Variance above what's expected for that mean
hvg = names(sort(excess, decreasing = TRUE))[1:200]
head(hvg, 20)


# Patient level: sum the counts of all cells per patient -> 2000 genes x 30 patients
pb = sapply(split(seq_len(ncol(data)), meta$patient), function(i) rowSums(data[, i]))
pb_group = factor(meta$group[match(colnames(pb), meta$patient)], levels = c("control", "disease"))

dge = DGEList(pb, group = pb_group)
dge = calcNormFactors(dge)                      # TMM normalisation

keep = filterByExpr(dge, group = pb_group)
sum(keep)                                        # Number of genes kept
dge = dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge$samples                                      # Library sizes and TMM factors

logcpm = cpm(dge, log = TRUE)    # genes x 30 patients, log2 CPM

# Normalisation check: one box per patient, should sit at the same level
boxplot(logcpm, las = 2, col = ifelse(pb_group == "control", "lightblue", "salmon"),
        ylab = "log2 CPM", main = "Per subject after TMM normalisation")


```

## 4. Patient-level data

```{r}

# Variance vs mean on normalized counts across the subjects
gene_vars = apply(logcpm, 1, var) 
gene_means = apply(logcpm, 1, mean)
plot(gene_means, gene_vars, log = "y", xlab = "Mean log2 CPM", ylab = "Variance across subjects")

# MDS plot
plotMDS(dge, col = ifelse(pb_group == "control", "blue", "red"), pch = 16)

# PCA per patient (centred, so PC1 shows differences between patients)
pca = prcomp(t(logcpm))
var_explained = round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 1)

plot(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2], col = ifelse(pb_group == "control", "blue", "red"), pch = 16,
     xlab = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], " %)"), ylab = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], " %)"))
text(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2], labels = colnames(logcpm), pos = 3, cex = 0.7)
legend("bottom", c("control", "disease"), col = c("blue", "red"), pch = 16, bty = "n", horiz = TRUE)


# Variance explained per PC
barplot(var_explained, names.arg = seq_along(var_explained), xlab = "PCs",
        ylab = "Proportion of variance (%)", col = "skyblue")


# Unsupervised check: do the patients split into two groups without using the labels?
set.seed(1)
km_pat = kmeans(pca$x[, 1:5], centers = 2, nstart = 25)
table(cluster = km_pat$cluster, label = pb_group)

```

## 4b. Relabel P02 as control

P02 is labelled disease, but in the patient PCA it sits among the controls, and k-means also puts it in the control cluster. We treat this as an intentional mislabelling and relabel P02 as control. Everything after this point uses the corrected labels.

```{r}

# Keep the original labels for comparison
pb_group_original = pb_group
meta$group_original = meta$group

# Relabel P02 as control: patient level (pseudobulk) and cell level
pb_group[colnames(pb) == "P02"] = "control"
meta$group[meta$patient == "P02"] = "control"
dge$samples$group = pb_group

table(original = pb_group_original, corrected = pb_group)   # one patient moved
table(pb_group)                                              # now 15 control, 15 disease

# PCA again, now coloured by the corrected labels
plot(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2], col = ifelse(pb_group == "control", "blue", "red"), pch = 16,
     xlab = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], " %)"), ylab = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], " %)"),
     main = "Subjects, corrected labels")
text(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2], labels = colnames(logcpm), pos = 3, cex = 0.7)

```

## 5. Cell-level analysis

```{r}

# PCA of the cells, on the 200 highly variable genes (scaled)
pca_cells = prcomp(t(lognorm[hvg, ]), scale. = TRUE)
var_cells = pca_cells$sdev^2 / sum(pca_cells$sdev^2)
barplot(var_cells[1:30], names.arg = 1:30, xlab = "PCs", ylab = "Proportion of variance", col = "skyblue")

pca_embed = pca_cells$x[, 1:10]   # first 10 components, used for the clustering

# K-means: elbow plot to choose the number of clusters
set.seed(1)
wss = sapply(2:10, function(k) kmeans(pca_embed, centers = k, nstart = 10)$tot.withinss)
plot(2:10, wss, type = "b", xlab = "Number of clusters (k)", ylab = "Within-cluster sum of squares")

# K-means with 7 clusters
set.seed(1)
km = kmeans(pca_embed, centers = 7, nstart = 25)

# Number the clusters by size (1 = largest), so the numbering is the same on every computer
size_rank = rank(-table(km$cluster), ties.method = "first")
cluster = factor(size_rank[as.character(km$cluster)])
table(cluster)

# PCA of the cells: coloured by cluster, and by group
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(pca_embed[,1], pca_embed[,2], pch = 16, cex = 0.4, col = rainbow(7)[cluster],
     xlab = "PC1", ylab = "PC2", main = "Cells by cluster")
legend("topright", paste("Cluster", levels(cluster)), col = rainbow(7), pch = 16, cex = 0.6, bty = "n")
plot(pca_embed[,1], pca_embed[,2], pch = 16, cex = 0.4,
     col = ifelse(meta$group == "control", "#2f6db380", "#c2412d80"),
     xlab = "PC1", ylab = "PC2", main = "Cells by group")
legend("topright", c("control", "disease"), col = c("#2f6db3", "#c2412d"), pch = 16, cex = 0.6, bty = "n")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))


# PCA of the cells, coloured by subject
plot(pca_embed[,1], pca_embed[,2], pch = 16, cex = 0.4,
     col = rainbow(30)[as.integer(factor(meta$patient))],
     xlab = "PC1", ylab = "PC2", main = "Cells by subject")


# UMAP of the cells, on the same 10 PCs, coloured by cluster
set.seed(43)
umap_res <- umap(pca_embed,
                 n_neighbors = 30, min_dist = 0.3)
plot(umap_res$layout, pch = 16,
     cex = 0.3, col = rainbow(7)[cluster], main = "UMAP",
     xlab = "UMAP 1", ylab = "UMAP 2")
legend("topright", paste("Cluster", levels(cluster)), col = rainbow(7), pch = 16, cex = 0.6, bty = "n")

```

## 6. Differential expression

```{r}

# Design + contrast (disease vs control), corrected labels from 4b
designMatrix   <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data = data.frame(group = pb_group))
contrastMatrix <- makeContrasts(groupdisease - groupcontrol, levels = designMatrix)

# Fit model
dge_disp <- estimateDisp(dge, designMatrix, robust = TRUE)
fit <- glmQLFit(dge_disp, designMatrix, robust = TRUE)

# Test
res <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrastMatrix)
res <- topTags(res, n = Inf)
sigRes <- subset(res$table, FDR < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 1)
nrow(sigRes)

# Volcano plot
ggplot(res$table, aes(logFC, -log10(FDR),
                      color = ifelse(FDR < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 1, "darkred", "grey"))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_text_repel(data = res$table[1:15, ], aes(label = rownames(res$table)[1:15]),
                  color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("darkred", "grey")) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Log2 fold change", y = "-log10 adjusted p-value")

# Heatmap of the significant genes (same genes as in sigRes)
pheatmap(logcpm[rownames(sigRes), ], scale = "row",
         annotation_col = data.frame(group = pb_group, row.names = colnames(logcpm)),
         main = "Significant genes, all 30 subjects (z-score per gene)")
```
